requirements.title: Security and Compliance
requirements.description: Ensuring the system's security and compliance with regulations.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: System performance and scalability infrastructure, including system performance

requirements.title: Communication Tools with Email Tracking
requirements.description: Built-in email composer with template library and merge fields, and email tracking with real-time notifications

requirements.title: Real-time Index Updates
requirements.description: Real-time index updates via CDC using Debezium from PostgreSQL WAL with index lag < 2 seconds

requirements.title: Multi-tenant Architecture
requirements.description: Multi-tenant architecture using tenant_id column on all tables with row-level security policies

requirements.title: Data Partitioning
requirements.description: Activity and EmailThread tables partitioned by created_at quarter with retention: 3 years in hot storage, 7 years in cold archive

requirements.title: Data Model
requirements.description: Company entity with fields: company_id, name, domain, industry, employee_count, annual_revenue, parent_company_id, clearbit_data, created_at, updated_at, and relationships between Lead, Contact, Company, Deal, and Activity entities

requirements.title: Lead and Email Management
requirements.description: Features for managing leads and emails, including detail panels, assignment workflows, qualification, conversion, enrichment, composition, integration, and automated sequences.
requirements.user_story: As a sales representative, I want to manage leads and emails, so that I can qualify and convert leads into deals and communicate with contacts and leads efficiently.

requirements.title: Lead Management
requirements.description: Lead capture from web forms, email, API, and manual entry with AI lead scoring based on firmographics, engagement, and fit

requirements.title: Meeting Scheduler
requirements.description: Meeting scheduler with calendar availability sharing link

requirements.title: DocuSign eSign API Integration
requirements.description: Generate contracts from CRM templates, send for signature, track signing status, and auto-update deal stage on completion using DocuSign eSign API

requirements.title: Custom Reports
requirements.description: Drag-and-drop report builder with filters, grouping, and chart types, scheduled report delivery via email in PDF or CSV format

requirements.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
requirements.description: Executive dashboard with KPIs: revenue, pipeline value, win rate, avg deal size, revenue forecast with AI-driven prediction and confidence intervals

requirements.title: Activity Management
requirements.description: Entity to manage activities with fields like activity_id, type, subject, body, contact_id, deal_id, owner_id, duration_minutes, scheduled_at, completed_at, outcome, created_at, and updated_at

requirements.title: Backup and Recovery
requirements.description: Ensuring data backup and recovery capabilities

requirements.title: API Access and Rate Limiting
requirements.description: Providing secure API access with rate limiting

requirements.title: Multi-Region Deployment
requirements.description: Deploying the system across multiple regions

requirements.title: System Uptime and Maintenance
requirements.description: Ensuring system uptime and maintaining it

requirements.title: Webhook Delivery Guarantees
requirements.description: Guaranteeing reliable webhook delivery

requirements.title: Integration Management
requirements.description: Features for configuring and managing integrations with other services, including calendar and third-party integrations, and their settings.
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to configure integrations, so that I can extend the functionality of our CRM.

requirements.title: Deal Management
requirements.description: Features for managing deals, including screens for deal management, Kanban board view, and deal pipeline progression.
requirements.user_story: As a sales representative, I want to manage deals effectively, so that I can track the sales pipeline and close deals.

requirements.title: Reporting and Data Management
requirements.description: Features for building custom reports and exporting data in suitable formats, including CSV and JSON with GDPR compliance.
requirements.user_story: As a sales manager, I want to build custom reports and export data, so that I can quickly access key information and make data-driven decisions.
